label: Glass Pasteur Pipette with Latex Bulb
description: A tapered glass tube used for the precise drop-by-drop application of liquid consolidants to fossil surfaces.

components.function: Allows for high-visibility placement of adhesive.
The 'spatula' end used to create suction and controlled release of liquid.
Keeps tips elevated and prevents cross-contamination between different concentrations of B-72.

game_mechanics.surface_tension_physics: Player must tap the tip of the pipette to a crack to trigger 'capillary action,' drawing the glue deep into the bone.
game_mechanics.clog_timer: If the player leaves B-72 in the glass stem too long, it hardens, requiring the player to 'dispose' of the tool and grab a new one.
